narr: A surge of deep tropical moisture moving north over South Florida interacted with an upper level trough over the eastern Gulf of Mexico to produce widespread heavy showers and thunderstorms through most of the day on May 20th. Some of these showers and storms produced high rainfall amounts, resulting in flooding. Funnel clouds were also reported in the Boca Raton area.
ev: Reports of significant flooding in the NW 2 Avenue and Dixie Highway corridors of Boca Raton from NW 20 Street to Palmetto Park Road. Water entered the public library as well as City Hall and a few businesses. NW 8 Street just east of NW 2 Avenue had water at least 1 foot deep covering the roadway, and side streets in the area were impassable. Rainfall amounts in the immediate area were as high as 8 inches in just over 3 hours.
